name: news-ticker
title: News ticker
description: A band along the bottom with a label tab, scrolling a list of headlines to the left without a seam, that slides up, runs for its length and slides away. Headlines are a JSON list of strings; set Length to the clip's data-duration.

variables.label: Headlines (JSON list of strings)
variables.default: ["Verdandi routes every task to the cheapest model that finishes it","Cost per completed task down 61% since routing shipped","New: render videos from plain HTML in one command","Checkpoints let you revert any turn without touching your branch"]

variables.label: Length in seconds (0: match the clip)
